### Description of your changes

Relates to https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/issues/4729

If Crossplane v2 wasn't exciting enough, we're now planning to implement alpha support the "operation functions" proposal we've had in the wings for a while as part of v2.0.0 release. This'll allow you to use a similar paradigm to Crossplane's composition functions to handle arbitrary day two operations - think database backups, rolling upgrades, etc.
